title: Start a practice repository
summary: A repository is a project whose history Git tracks. Initialise only a new practice directory for this lesson.
introduction: A repository is a project whose history Git tracks. Initialise only a new practice directory for this lesson. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A repository is a project whose history Git tracks. Initialise only a new practice directory for this lesson.

blocks.code:
mkdir learning-git
cd learning-git
git init
blocks.title: Start a practice repository

blocks.text: Git creates its hidden .git directory inside learning-git. That directory holds the repository information.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Run git status inside the new folder.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not initialise or change an unrelated system folder.
For more detail later, use this [Git further reading](https://git-scm.com/docs/gittutorial).

seo.title: Git: Start a practice repository
seo.description: Learn about start a practice repository in Git. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
